subject: Follow-up: Forensics log package & sample rows (who/when access)
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@eversafe.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@eversafe.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Forensics log package & sample rows (who/when access)

Hi Lisa / Tom — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can align on what you need for your compliance review.

Key asks you raised on the call:
- A downloadable "who/when" access export (who accessed which model/resource, timestamp, action) for audit and forensics.
- Preferred format: CSV (one compressed file) plus a small JSON example you can ingest.
- Sample deliverable: 50–100 sanitized rows covering the last 90 days for validation before we provide a larger export.
- Retention policy question: you indicated a requirement for ~18 months of logs for regulatory purposes; please confirm.
- Data residency: production data must remain in our eu-west region for EU customers; confirm whether you want exports delivered from EU or US.
- PII handling: you asked that prompts and any raw PII be redacted unless explicitly authorized; hashed identifiers (SHA256) are acceptable for linking events.

From our side (high level):
- We can produce CSV with the following columns: timestamp, request_id, user_id_hash, internal_user_email (if internal audit requested), user_role, action_type (query/generate/view), resource_id, model_version, prompt_hash, bytes_returned, latency_ms, source_ip_region. If you need extra columns call them out.
- We will not include raw prompt text by default; we can provide prompt_hash and prompt_metadata (token counts, truncated indicator). If you require raw prompts for a specific subset, we need a signed data-access addendum and a narrow scope.
- Export delivery options: secure S3 presigned link (time-limited), encrypted Drive folder, or a shared SFTP endpoint.

Action items / timeline proposal:
1) You confirm: retention window (months), desired export columns, and whether you need model prompt text for the sample. (Needed: by EOD 2027-03-23)
2) We will produce a sanitized CSV sample (50 rows) and a short readme describing schema — delivery 2027-03-24.
3) Engineering demo / walkthrough of the export + retrieval process — propose 2027-03-25 11:00 PT (30 minutes).

Attachments: I have attached a short example schema stub (export-schema-v1.csv) and will follow up with timing once we get your confirmation.

Thanks — I will own coordination here.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

---
Attachment: export-schema-v1.csv (CSV schema stub)

From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@eversafe.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@eversafe.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Mar 2027 15:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Forensics log package & sample rows (who/when access)

Thanks Priya — that summary is perfect. A couple clarifications from the security/compliance team so the sample is useful for our auditors: 

1) Retention window: we require 18 months for access logs in production. For the initial sample, please provide the last 90 days.
2) Columns: please include these exactly if possible: event_timestamp (ISO8601 UTC), request_id (UUID), user_id_hash (sha256; we will provide a salt if needed), user_role (application|admin|service), action (read|write|generate|delete|config_change), resource_type (model|dataset|config|secret), resource_id, model_version, prompt_hash, prompt_truncated (true/false), response_tokens, latency_ms, source_ip, geo_region, auth_method (api_key|oauth|sso), svc_account (if applicable).
3) PII: do NOT include raw prompt text in the sample. For a narrow forensic review we may need raw prompts for a handful of events (we will supply request_ids in the scope), but that requires an NDA addendum / DPA clause and justification.
4) Delivery: prefer encrypted S3 presigned links delivered to our compliance mailbox.

Also attaching a short doc which lists Eversafe's audit expectations (eversafe-compliance-ask.docx).

Can you confirm you can provide the sanitized 90-day sample in CSV with the column set above and a short readme explaining redaction rules? If so we will schedule the demo for 3/25 as you suggested.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — auditors are on a tight timeline.

Regards,
Lisa Chen
Head of Security & Compliance, Eversafe Financial
lisa.chen@eversafe.com | +1 212-555-0144

---
Attachment: eversafe-compliance-ask.docx (customer requirements doc)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@eversafe.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Mar 2027 09:05:33 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Forensics log package & sample rows (who/when access)

Lisa / Priya — thanks, we can deliver what you've outlined. Technical notes and one constraint to flag: 

- We will produce the CSV columns requested. For user_id_hash we will apply SHA256 with a customer-supplied salt if you provide one; otherwise we will use an internal salt and flag that in the readme.
- We will not include raw prompt content unless you provide explicit written approval for the narrow request_ids you mentioned. For the sanitized sample you'll get prompt_hash + prompt_truncated boolean + token counts.
- Model/version: we can emit the exact model_version string used for each request.
- Export size: for the full 18-month window, we estimate ~12GB compressed for your current usage pattern; we will provide a cost/time estimate and a delivery plan once you confirm retention.
- Delivery method: we will stage the file in an encrypted S3 bucket in eu-west (per your data residency note) and provide a time-limited presigned link. If you prefer the file exported from our US region, tell us and we will change the staging location.

Planned schedule:
- 3/24: deliver sanitized 90-day sample (CSV 50–100 rows) + readme + schema.
- 3/25 11:00 PT: demo of export process + Q&A (Marissa will run the demo).
- 3/29: if sample approved, produce larger export for the 18-month window and provide final delivery plan.

I attached a quick example schema (export-schema-v1.csv) — contains exact column order we will use. If you need additional fields we can add them but that may change extraction time.

Karthik — can your team prepare the DPA language / audit addendum template so Lisa's legal team can sign if they request raw prompt access?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Engineering — Inference Platform, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0123
